content:
Best Buy has refreshed its major 60th anniversary celebration sale with a new round of price drops. We're still seeing AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 down $120, and AirTag 2 at its lowest price ever. But today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also brings a massive $500 off on the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro at Amazon, Anker's all-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card at a new low of $25, and Mint Mobile launching an unprecedented 50% off deal on Unlimited yearly talk and data plans at just $15/month. Scroll down to take it all in.

Best Buy refreshes its massive 60th anniversary celebration sale with a new round of price drops: TVs starting from $110, electronics up to 50% off, appliances with $1,000 off, and more

AirPods deals see further price drops, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off and more

After a summer of deals on Apple's latest AirPods lineup, nearly every model has fallen to new low prices. The highly-anticipated AirPods Pro 3 is now among its lowest prices ever at 25% off, AirPods 4 with ANC has dropped to its lowest price in months, and AirPods Max 2 just saw prices dip another $120 off this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

Rare deal: M4 Mac mini drops $150 today via Apple's official refurbished store

Update: This deal has sold out, we'll keep an eye out for restocks.

AirPods Pro 3 and the all-new AirTag 2, M5 MacBook Pro, and other models have seen solid deals lately, but the latest M4 Mac mini has been tough to come by. Deals that were once commonplace at retailers like Amazon and Best Buy have all but dried up. Now we're tracking a rare opportunity to score a 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini for $150 off via Apple's official refurbished store.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now selling the M4 Mac mini with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $849 with free shipping.

New low: 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro sees massive $500 price drop at Amazon

This week has already brought $400 price drops on some all-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations as part of Apple's special one-day event. But we wanted to spotlight this model in particular — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB built-in SSD for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the configuration that originally retailed for $3,199, with an upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (rather than the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU version that's now $400 off). Although this model just went up in price, it's still $100 below the older MSRP.

Both are solid options depending on how much performance you need — now $400 and $500 off respectively, you'd normally pay $200 extra for the CPU/GPU upgrade, but with today's deals it's just $100 more:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We expect this $500 price drop to disappear soon, but whether it lasts until Sunday (when this week's massive sale event ends) remains to be seen.

Apple's latest AirTag 2 hits new low at Amazon this week, but here's how to get one for $20

Apple deals have been everywhere this week, with AirPods Pro 3 holding steady at 25% off and the latest AirPods Max 2 also seeing one of its best-ever price drops at $120 off. Along with $500 off select M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations, some notable discounts have also landed on their latest AirTag 2 trackers — both the single and 4-packs are back at all-time lows — but you can also score one for $20 right now.

Amazon has now dropped both the AirTag 2 single and 4-pack to the lowest prices we've tracked since they launched earlier this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

That's an average of just $22.25 per unit for the 4-pack, while the single AirTag 2 is back to its Prime Day all-time low of $24.

While the price isn't much different, it's worth noting that Best Buy's "excellent" grade open-box AirTag 2 single units are also at the lowest we've tracked — you can snag one for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 "excellent" open-box $20 (originally $29 new) | Best Buy

While it's only $4 less than Amazon's brand-new units, I'd personally go with the new unit myself, but it is indeed the lower price. Best Buy also has the same deal on new units, so if you're already placing an order from the 60th anniversary sale, it's worth checking out those options too.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary week deals take $100 off, Best Buy open-box from $254

Anker's all-new SmartTrack Find My wallet card works with iOS or Android, now at $25 all-time low at Amazon

Anker recently launched its all-new SmartTrack Find My Card — its first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub — and now it's down to a new all-time low of $25 at Amazon with free shipping for Prime members.

Anker's official EufyHome Amazon store is now selling this all-new SmartTrack Card E40 (compatible with iOS or Android) for $24.99, with free shipping for Prime members or orders over $35.

This card only launched on Amazon last month at $35, then saw a modest $5 discount, and is now seeing its first significant price drop to a new all-time low on Amazon.

That's nearly a 30% discount, with pricing comparable to deals we've seen on similar wallet tracker cards this year.

I'm personally a huge fan of Nomad's Tracking Cards — starting from $35, with the Pro model offering up to 16 months of battery life before needing a recharge at $45 — but no matter which you choose, I think everyone should put one in their wallet or cardholder. I never leave home without mine.

Anker's latest SmartTrack Card E40 has all the most important features, including wireless charging, while also supporting both Apple's Find My platform or Google's Find Hub. At just 1.7mm thin with up to 80dB of volume to help you locate it nearby. Of course, it loads directly into both Find My and Find Hub apps so you can see its location on a map.

Mint Mobile now offers an unprecedented 50% off on Unlimited yearly talk and data plans at just $15/month

Mint Mobile is now running some solid deals on unlimited 5G/4G LTE cell phone plans. While this carrier offers pretty good value most of the time, they're now offering their Unlimited 12-month plan for just $15/month — that's 50% off, or just $180 for the whole year with unlimited talk, text, and data. Even if you don't plan to switch your primary line right now, this pricing is low enough to be worth considering as a backup or secondary iPad line.

While their 17GB and 23GB plans are also discounted, the best deal here is the 5G • 4G LTE plans: Unlimited data/MO for 12 months at just $15/month.

  • Mint Mobile Unlimited 12-month plan $15/month (50% off)

According to the fine print here, you'll need to prepay the $180 for the 12-month plan (which works out to $15/month), but for anyone looking to switch carriers at a discount price or add a secondary line for other devices/as a backup, this is a really solid deal.

You can "activate service instantly if your phone supports eSIM," and it works with major Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. You can keep your existing number and bring an unlocked phone to the service if needed.

Head over to the deal page for more details.

The all-new wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits new low at Amazon with nearly 30% off (wired version discounted too)

As part of their late-summer slate of deals on Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home gear, Amazon is also offering the lowest prices ever on the all-new wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro while bringing back Prime Day all-time lows on the wired model — both hovering around 30% off MSRP.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker's MagSafe chargers this week start from $36 with free shipping (multiple colors available)
  • Anker's 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is one of the best options out there, now 35% off (matching all-time low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the nicest-looking MagSafe stands I've seen, down to $27 (originally $35)
  • Twelve South's all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C charger now down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker's Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable is just $36 today
  • Woot's massive PC sale kicks off with up to 75% off gaming desktops, monitors, coolers, and more, deals from $5
  • This compact SSD enclosure with display features power-off protection, now $29
  • Razer's portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub drops to $52 all-time low (57% off)
  • Twelve South's USB-C wall charger with Find My support hits new Amazon low at under $37
  • Wow! These leather Apple Watch bands are just $6 with Prime shipping (75% off)

Amazon now has all five colors of AirPods Max 2 in stock at $120 off (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th anniversary celebration brings one of the best prices ever on Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now taking $120 off all five colors at MSRP.

Amazon is now offering Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

That's $120 off the same $549 MSRP as the previous generation, making it the best price right now for brand-new units from a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have Midnight black units in "excellent" grade open-box condition for $403.99 with free shipping, which is cheaper but might not be enough to give up on brand-new.

Apple has truly delivered a next-gen AirPods Max this year, unlike the previous generation that just got new colors and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, they won't be updating this over-ear option in next month's new releases, so this week's $120 discount might be the biggest price drop on Apple's over-ear headphones for some time.

The only time they've ever sold for less was during this summer's Prime Day, where prices dropped $30 below what we're seeing today during the 4-day sale event, but stock was quite limited and inconsistent at the time.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models now $220 off (matching Prime Day pricing)

While Apple's official certified refurbished store is my first stop for iPhone deals, Apple isn't currently selling the latest iPhone 17 Pro models there — that won't happen until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed models are now back at Prime Day pricing, with up to $220 off new MSRP.

Amazon's highest-quality Premium Renewed models have consistently been the best option for scoring unlocked iPhone 17 Pro deals right now. Not only do you save several hundred dollars, but you also get a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and ">90% of original battery life" — non-"premium" Renewed and refurbished units on Amazon only come with 90-day warranties and have no comparable battery life rating.

Right now you can find 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models back in stock again at up to $220 off — with the 512GB being $20 less than previously mentioned:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)

As featured in yesterday's Apple refurbished store spotlight, you can grab fully-functional iPhone 16 models with 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699, and the 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — that's $330 less than the comparable 17 Pro Max and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 starting from $699 (up to $330 less than the 17 series)

Anker's 45W Nano smart display charger holds at $26 low, and now you can get a bundle with a USB-C cable for just $4 more
